result:
I checked the one HIGH finding and it is a false alarm, so I made no code change and shipped nothing.

The reviewer guessed that a later `lbCountStart` call puts `data-to` on `#haultot`. That never happens. `lbCountStart` and `lbCountEnd` only touch elements that already have `data-to`, and `#haultot` is built without it (line 31220). The only other code that writes to it, `haulTotalLine`, writes a `$` figure. The haul value therefore stays in dollars. The money figures that do count up carry `data-m`, so they also keep their `$`.

I wrote the verdict to `tools/handoff/console/notes/50-review-20261017.md`. The review's other findings are all MED, so they were outside this task and I didn't look at them.

TASK DONE
